doc.name: Artemis GTM
doc.description: Artemis GTM (artemisgtm.ai) is a GTM engineering firm for seed to Series C B2B startups. It builds, implements and deploys outbound and inbound GTM systems inside the client's own CRM and tools with its proprietary agent architecture, led hands-on by founder Tom Regan; clients keep the systems, the architecture stays with the firm. This card and the MCP endpoint are read-only: they describe the firm and point to an evaluation call. Not affiliated with BrandJet AI's Artemis.
